body:
I've started to work on the next draft of template for issues and created the minimal standard as a Markdown Task List below:

- [ ] An existing issue was not found within https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues?q=is%3Aissue+InsertSearchTerm
- [ ] The Markdown has been searched in its entirety with https://github.com/search?q=in%3Afile+repo%3AOWASP%2FASVS+InsertSearchTerm&type=Code _raised wtihin https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1086#issuecomment-950253958_
- [ ] Cited the specific line[s] of the specific requirement[s] with ["Blame"](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/working-with-files/using-files/tracking-changes-in-a-file)
- [ ] Listed the a parent[s] or child issue[s] of this new issue if any
- [ ] Listed the related Pull Requests to this issue
- [ ] This issue is a breaking change intended for the next major release [and should not be merged into the associated minor release]
- [ ] This issue is not a breaking change to the current major release and can be merged into an upcoming minor release

I've excluded creating an [Issue Form](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/using-templates-to-encourage-useful-issues-and-pull-requests/configuring-issue-templates-for-your-repository#creating-issue-forms) as this is still in beta below:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/136826/139176828-b5f42303-90be-4b2a-a172-7b98cb7794b6.png)

Please let me know if I have missed any before I raise a PR to replace the existing template in the `.github` directory?

comments.body:
Hey, hold your horses. It is recommendation for you from issue to issue.

Some rhetorical questions:
* What is the problem you going to solve with that?
* Is this problem actually there and have you validated it?
* Or what problems you going to create with that?
* Have you discussed with any lead, that there is problem to solve, that you start working on it?

I'm watching and maintaining issue list - comments in the beginning of issue templates works well.

We don't have problem with duplicate issues.

No one is going to make this research and if this is precondition for open an issue, we will not have any issues.

It's not possible to decide, is it breaking change when you open an issue - it may be proposal, change will come from discussions and decision comes when the release is going to happen.
